Added tests cover stale passes, changed limits, zero-success closure/reopen, reverse physical-send ordering, PTO allowances, exact 64-KiB quantum, clock/identity/time overflow and worker/group fairness.

Normal all-feature musl release binaries without temporary instrumentation. Nine ascending candidate points retain daemons through 0.5/1/2/3/4/8/16/21G offered then unlimited. Matched pair starts fresh baseline then candidate daemons, each retained through 21G/unlimited/21G return. No builds, other tests or Git packing overlap load.

Candidate's longer relative goodput changes are +25.68/+7.75% at first21G, +6.44/-0.91% unlimited, and +7.48/-6.13% on return.
